in_hebrew.name: רַחֶם
in_hebrew.long_meaning: A Hebrew name derived from the root 'racham' meaning 'to be soft, to have compassion, to show mercy'. It is often associated with God's mercy and kindness towards His people.

in_greek.name: ἲας
in_greek.long_meaning: A Greek name derived from the word 'ias' meaning 'healer'. In Greek mythology, Ias was a god of the rain and healing. It is unrelated to the name Raine as given.

in_latin.name: Raina
in_latin.long_meaning: A Latin name derived from the word 'raina' meaning 'rain'. It is unrelated to the name Raine as given.
